title: Sega pulls Total War: Shogun 2 remaster from sale following disastrous launch
script:
Sega removed Total War: Shogun 2 Complete Edition from digital storefronts after a disastrous launch.
Players reported distorted character models and UI glitches throughout the updated strategy experience.
The community found textures that suggest the developer used AI for lazy upscaling.
The remaster launched Tuesday to bundle the original 2011 base game with all its expansions.
It currently holds overwhelmingly negative reviews on Steam following the botched release.
Sega has not announced a date for when the game will return to storefronts.
Should developers be held accountable for low-effort AI upscaling in remasters?
